name: CMC Foods, Inc.
old_description: CMC Foods specializes in the procurement, packaging and distribution of edible oils, vinegars and cooking wines. We operate under the principle of providing competitively priced, high-quality products with exceptional service.
about:
CMC Foods, Inc. operates from its headquarters in Kansas City, Missouri, with additional facilities in Hot Springs, Arkansas, and Atlanta, Georgia. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company specializes in the procurement, packaging, and distribution of edible oils, vinegars, and cooking wines. It runs three strategically located plants equipped with state-of-the-art filling lines, offering services that include bulk tanker and tote delivery, food-service and retail packaging, and custom labeling. CMC Foods serves both national accounts and independent operators, emphasizing flexibility in order size and product specifications.

Its customer base spans food-service distributors, retail chains, and other food manufacturers, ranging from Fortune 500 companies to small independent businesses. The firm’s quality system is built on third-party audited Good Manufacturing Practices and holds certifications from the Safe Quality Food Institute (SQF), the Orthodox Union (OU) for kosher products, the Non-GMO Project, and the USDA Organic program.

CMC Foods states that its competitive advantage lies in combining the scale to supply large national accounts with the agility to accommodate individual customer needs, all while maintaining competitively priced, high-quality products and exceptional service.

name: CMI ELECTRIC, INC.

about:
CMI Electric, Inc. is based in Newark, Delaware, and has served the Delmarva region since 1998. The company provides electrical and solar installation services across Delaware, Maryland, and Pennsylvania. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The firm offers a range of electrical services including 24/7 emergency response, aluminum wiring repair using Copalum connectors, wiring for appliances, HVAC, and generators, as well as underground wiring, code-compliant rewiring, and smoke/CO detector installation. It also installs solar photovoltaic systems, energy-efficient lighting, and standby generators. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

CMI works with residential and commercial customers throughout the tri-state area. Examples include homeowners needing aluminum wiring remediation, businesses upgrading to LED lighting, and property owners installing solar arrays or backup generators. The company references participation in the Delaware Green Energy Program and memberships in solar industry associations.

CMI emphasizes that it is fully licensed and insured and uses only UL-listed materials. A customer testimonial on its site highlights the company's focus on customer satisfaction above all else.

name: CMI Plastics
old_description: From custom shipping trays to protective product packaging, our experienced team specializes in packaging solutions with fast turnaround times.
about:
CMI Plastics operates from Ayden, North Carolina, where it was founded in 1939. The company is a third-generation family-owned business that began as a custom packaging designer and manufacturer.

The company specializes in custom thermoformed packaging, including blister packs, clamshells, and trays. All design, tooling, and manufacturing are performed in-house using advanced CAM for tooling fabrication and robotics for automated packaging. The Ayden facility is expanding by 60,000 square feet to increase thermoforming capacity. The firm offers rapid prototyping that delivers samples in days, followed by rigorous package testing.

CMI serves the automotive and industrial, consumer products, food, and medical and pharmaceutical sectors. Notable customers include R.J. Reynolds Vapor, recognized as a Most Valuable Partner. The company tailors solutions for each industry’s requirements, from protective shipping trays to shelf-ready consumer packaging.

CMI emphasizes sustainability through recycled materials and circular production practices, aiming to reduce plastic usage—one project cut a client’s consumption by over a million pounds annually. The company cites its hands-on, partnership-driven approach, in-house engineering control, and quality certifications as key differentiators.

name: CO Lumber & Real Wood Furniture
old_description: Founded in 1981, CO Lumber began as a humble unfinished furniture store with a one-person woodworking shop and a simple mission: build quality products and ensure every customer received exactly what they envisioned. That commitment to craftsmanship and personalized service quickly earned the trust of homeowners, contractors, and woodworkers throughout the community.
about:
CO Lumber & Real Wood Furniture operates from Colorado Springs, Colorado, where it was founded in 1981 as a modest unfinished furniture store with a one-person woodworking shop. The business remains locally owned and operated, having grown from that single shop into one of the largest hardwood retailers and custom woodworking facilities in El Paso County.

The company supplies a broad range of wood products including domestic and exotic hardwoods, softwoods, plywood, mouldings, and live-edge slabs such as Monkey Pod. Its custom woodworking shop produces finished and unfinished furniture, cabinetry, architectural millwork, and custom pieces for homeowners, contractors, and designers. The facility also offers complimentary cuts on sheet goods and maintains what it describes as the area’s most comprehensive moulding selection.

Customers span residential construction, remodeling, furniture making, and DIY woodworking. Builders, remodelers, designers, and individual craftsmen source materials and custom millwork for kitchens, furniture, and architectural details. The company also stocks Amish-made furniture lines and serves both professional tradespeople and retail buyers.

The founding mission emphasized building quality products and delivering exactly what each customer envisioned, a commitment the company says remains unchanged after four decades. It differentiates itself through owner-operated attention, a wide inventory of premium hardwoods, and a custom shop capable of handling projects from small DIY jobs to large-scale commercial millwork.

name: CTAC Solutions | Colorado Telephone and Cable
old_description: We provide reliable, scalable telecom solutions that enhance communication and boost efficiency for businesses and individuals alike.
about:
CTAC Solutions, based in Aurora, Colorado, has served the Denver metro area since 1996. Founded as Colorado Telephone and Cable, the family-owned, minority- and women-owned business rebranded in 2024 to reflect its expanded portfolio. The company is led by Eric Williams, who serves as engineer and CEO, alongside administrator Tamara Williams and lead field engineer Nathan Williams.

The firm designs, installs, and maintains telecommunications infrastructure for businesses of all sizes. As an authorized Avaya partner, it supplies and services new and certified pre-owned phone systems, including VoIP solutions. Its cabling division handles structured cabling (Cat6, Cat6A) and all low-voltage wiring for voice, data, audio, and video. Security offerings include Uniview-based surveillance cameras, DVR/NVR recording, and access-control systems. Additional services cover carrier optimization, network connectivity, IoT device management, and technology consulting. The company reports more than 1,000 completed projects and over 500 clients.

CTAC serves commercial customers across the Denver metropolitan region — including Centennial, Littleton, Westminster, Arvada, Boulder, Thornton, Lakewood, Parker, Greenwood Village, and Commerce City — as well as individual clients. Its client base ranges from small startups to large enterprises, and it also provides support to other telecom technicians, as noted by a Washington-state technician who relied on CTAC for remote assistance.

The company emphasizes its 25-plus years of industry experience, a comprehensive service model from installation through ongoing maintenance, and a customer-centric approach that promises real human support without automated phone trees. The rebrand to CTAC Solutions was driven by a desire to align with the full-spectrum solutions the team now delivers.

about:
CTI Industrial Supply was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada, with a retail location in Richardson, Texas. The company began as a distributor of industrial, safety, and auto body supplies, later expanding into auto paint and car care products.

Today the company operates both physical retail stores and an e-commerce site offering over 10,000 products. Its catalog spans adhesives, tapes, lubricants, woodworking supplies, custom paints and tints, and detailing products. CTI carries brands such as Luxfer, Mohawk, AutoMagic, Presta, and U-Pol, and also offers its own CTI-branded tools alongside OEM lines. A noted capability is specialty coatings.

The supplier serves automotive body shops, industrial maintenance teams, woodworking professionals, and detailing businesses. Customers range from small shops to larger operations seeking safety equipment, refinishing materials, and shop consumables.

CTI emphasizes product breadth and personalized assistance: its staff helps buyers navigate the online catalog or locate hard-to-find items, and the company promotes secure payment options and round-the-clock support.

name: CUE of Wv America-Beckley
old_description: C.U.E. specializes in custom molding urethane parts.  From small single runs to high-volume lines in custom work cells, C.U.E. can be your urethane molding partner.
about:
C.U.E., Inc. is headquartered in Mt Hope, West Virginia. The privately held company traces its roots to 1957, when it began as a custom urethane molding operation. No founders are named in available records.

The company specializes in cast polyurethane molding and product development, offering services from 3D CAD design and prototyping to dual-durometer molding, urethane-to-metal bonding, and net-shape parts. It operates three manufacturing facilities, including a Dallas, Texas plant serving the oil and gas sector, and employs over 100 people. Annual throughput exceeds 3 million pounds of urethane, with shipments reaching 60 countries.

C.U.E. serves the corrugated packaging industry as one of the largest makers of urethane anvil covers, the mining and aggregate sector with abrasion-resistant products, the oil and gas drilling industry, metal forming, plastics distribution and fabrication, and highway maintenance. It also produces standard urethane shapes such as bars, rods, tubes, and sheets.

The company emphasizes its six-decade expertise, a staff of mechanical, chemical, and industrial engineers, ISO 9001:2015 certification, and the ability to run both small single-run jobs and high-volume production in custom work cells.

Cable & Connections is based in West Columbia, South Carolina, and has been operating since 1997. The business is owned by Cable and Connections Acquisition Company LLC, though no individual founders are identified in public sources.

The company operates as a distributor and online retailer of connectivity and infrastructure products. Its catalog spans networking patch cables, fiber assemblies, keystone jacks, patch panels, rack shelves, projector mounts, and related tools and test equipment. Brands carried include Vertical Cable and VMP. The business serves customers through an e-commerce platform and offers business accounts.

Cable & Connections serves industries such as commercial networking, security and access control, audio/video installation, and data center infrastructure. Its customers include low-voltage contractors, IT integrators, and facility managers who need items like Cat6A slimline patch cables, fiber breakout assemblies, and rack-mount hardware.

The company emphasizes its long-standing presence since 1997 and claims to maintain the largest inventory of Vertical Cable products. It also highlights the addition of ProdataKey cloud-based access control systems to its lineup.

name: Cable Assembly
old_description: Founded in 1988, Cable Assembly serves major multinational customers, including a number of Fortune 500 companies, from its ISO 9001:2015 registered facility in Whitsett, North Carolina
about:
Cable Assembly, LLC was founded in 1988 in Whitsett, North Carolina. The company operates from a facility on Judge Adams Road and has grown into a preferred supplier for multinational customers, including numerous Fortune 500 firms.

The company specializes in wire harness and cable assembly manufacturing, along with electro-mechanical assembly. Its capabilities include ink jet and hot stamping, Kanban and just-in-time inventory programs, and engineering support that takes designs from concept through prototype to full-scale production. The facility is certified to ISO 9001:2015 and recognized by UL and CSA.

Cable Assembly serves a range of industrial markets: steam turbines, industrial equipment, HVAC systems, fuel dispensers, point-of-sale terminals, material handling equipment, construction and mining machinery, generators and air compressors, and energy management controls. Its customer base includes major multinational corporations and industry leaders across these sectors.

The company emphasizes its status as a certified LEAN enterprise, citing quick responsiveness, engineering expertise, and a team with deep wire-harness experience as key differentiators. It attributes its repeat business to reliability, resourcefulness, and a focus on total customer satisfaction.

about:
Cable Connection Inc., a BizLink Company, is headquartered in Fremont, California. The business was founded in 1996 in Los Gatos, California, and later acquired Wilco Wire Technology, moving its headquarters to Fremont. It operates as a subsidiary of BizLink Technology Inc.

The company manufactures custom cable assemblies, wire harnesses, box builds, electro‑mechanical assemblies, power cords, integrated electrical‑mechanical systems, printed circuit board assemblies, and specialty RF cables. Its services span design and engineering, new product introduction, quick‑turn prototyping, quality engineering, insert and over‑molding, micro CNC machining, cable braiding, ultrasonic welding, scalable manufacturing, and supply‑chain solutions. The firm reports 30‑plus years of experience, 99.5 % on‑time delivery, 99.8 % first‑pass yield, and a base of over 300 customers.

Cable Connection serves the medical, automotive, agriculture, communication‑network, industrial, semiconductor, and aerospace‑and‑defense sectors, supplying Fortune 500 OEMs and other original‑equipment manufacturers.

The company states its purpose is to “make great products that directly and indirectly enhance the quality of people’s lives.” Its vision emphasizes integrating cutting‑edge technology and innovation to produce high‑quality cables sustainably, while its mission targets being a provider of cable‑manufacturing solutions through continuous improvement, quality, and customer service. Core values include integrity, transparency, and accountability.
